about: Example mount rows (O14): how a stepper motor's flange and two bearing units fix to a flat face — bolt pattern, clearance holes, pilot, shaft and where its axis stands — each taken from the page it names. They are examples, not a standard: check each value against your part's own datasheet before manufacture (fields not cross-checked against a second source are listed in `unchecked`). No servo row is given: no maker's dimensioned mounting drawing was found to cite. Load the file yourself (attach it in chat, or the Library once it lists mounts); the agent cannot load rows of its own.

rows.designation: NEMA 17 (42 mm) stepper flange, metric M3 tapped holes
rows.source: NEMA 17 mounting dimensions: https://pic.hallikainen.org/techref/io/stepper/nemasizes.htm (bolt hole distance 1.220 in / 31 mm, pilot Ø0.866 in / 22 mm, pilot depth max 0.079 in / 2 mm, shaft Ø0.197 in / 5 mm)

fieldSources.pilotMM: NEMA ICS 16-2001 nominal pilot Ø0.8661 in, as quoted at https://us.aspina-group.com/en/learning-zone/columns/what-is/034/
fieldSources.shaftMM: NEMA ICS 16-2001 nominal shaft Ø0.1969 in, as quoted at https://us.aspina-group.com/en/learning-zone/columns/what-is/034/
fieldSources.holes: spacing: https://pic.hallikainen.org/techref/io/stepper/nemasizes.htm; Ø: ISO 273 medium clearance (samples/rows/fastener-sizes.json) for the motor's M3 tapped holes
fieldSources.clearanceMM: a choice for this example (0.5 mm all round the pilot), not a datasheet value
